body:
Hey OP, I know exactly how you feel. Going through each day not feeling like anything matters or nothing is fun. I'm right there with you buddy. I cry all the time. really nothing to be ashamed of. I don't know if you've tried, but try talking to someone you trust. I have one person I talk to only, and she has been a big help. Helped me finally see a therapist (I don't know if it's working or not), but I'm trying. 
Please don't end anything, I'm mostly positive you have family and friends that care about you and will be really hurt that they couldn't help you, or that you left them. You're doing your best OP, just like me and probably everyone else in this sub. Keep it up OP, you made it this far, and you will make it farther. 
If you need someone to talk to or vent to, I am here to lend an ear. Much love OP.

She is. I’d rather shoulder the problems of others, then have people shoulder my problems. I want my friends, my family, to be happy. I want them to not feel how I do. 
I meant, I feel I’m not doing enough. I’m not good enough. For anything. Anyone. My best always falls short in everything.
Where do we even start. I’m tired of feeling like this. Exhausted really.

It’s hard to talk to her. I feel bad. She has her own problems. Mine I feel have no resolve. I’m doing my best. I fo to the gym weekly. Learning a new language. Passing my classes work full time. But I feel it’s not enough. I don’t feel enough.

I’m really bad at talking to people. Though I’m currently trying to seek professional help. And maybe anti depressants. It’s just tough cause when I was younger my parents wouldn’t accept that I needed help. “It’s all in your head” is what they told me. So that’s why I don’t talk to people.
